name: Alert
blurb: A short message that calls out something worth noticing.
mechanism: Static markup plus the same tone classes the Toast uses. Dismiss is a `checkbox-and-:has()` trick in the demo, but the honest version is one line of script or a server round-trip.
caveats: An alert that matters must be announced: add role="alert" for errors, or aria-live="polite" for anything softer. Colour alone reaches nobody using a screen reader.
The dismiss shown here hides the alert but leaves it in the accessibility tree unless you also remove it - the checkbox version cannot do that.
